$comment: Mutation-score floor for the Stryker gate (#74). stryker-config.json's thresholds.break MUST equal 'floor' — Stryker exits non-zero below it, failing the weekly stryker.yaml run, which auto-files an issue. Ratchet policy: the floor only moves UP, in a PR that shows the new sustained score; lowering it requires a written rationale in the same PR. History lives in this file's git log.

measured.environment: local win-x64, dotnet-stryker latest, Release test suite (236 unit tests)

survivorProfile: Dominated by Statement (52) and String (41) mutations — removed logging calls and altered log/console message text, which the tests deliberately do not assert. Top files: Bundle.cs (24), Compress.cs (18), ArchiveVerifier.cs (18), SharedOptions.cs (15), CompressService.cs (15). Raising the floor meaningfully means either asserting key log output or configuring Stryker to ignore logging statements.
